Maria is a first-year ELLIS PhD student at the University of Amsterdam (AMLab) supervised by Prof.Erik Bekkers and co-supervised by Prof.Søren Hauberg. 
Her research interests lie in the intersection of machine learning, geometry and topology. 
She is currently working on understanding diffusion models through the lens of information geometry.
